audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 sits with the 47.4% win rate over 2154 games and with the mirror. The lane really is a range-tax early into a blink-window flip; no rating change.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text gave no cooldown anchors and treated her level 6 as the danger without naming Perfect Execution's 120/90/60s or Twilight Shroud's 20/19/18/17/16s.
audit.why: Her R falls to 60s at rank 3 while Purgatory only falls to 80s, so the late trade of ultimates is not symmetric; the shroud cooldown is the actual step-up window.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and mid/late now key the commit to her shroud and dash windows rather than a vague 'combo'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors: Five Point Strike was said to heal her; Purgatory was said to execute her 'out of her own shroud'; and a nonexistent 'shroud reset' was cited. Locke's Q was called Ritual Nails and the passive Silver Stake.
audit.why: Riot's Q text is damage plus slow only — no heal. Twilight Shroud makes her invisible AND unselectable by spells and attacks, so a targeted commit into the shroud does nothing; the real answer is Purgatory's grounding, which denies the Shuriken Flip recast dash and both Perfect Execution dashes. Locke's Q is Soul Nails in his own kit text; the passive has no name in the file.
audit.corrected: Q described as poke plus slow; Purgatory described as a grounding zone used as she exits the shroud; Soul Nails used; passive referred to by its missing-health on-hit effect.

edits.before: Akali wants to poke with Q Five Point Strike and heal, then all-in with E Shuriken Flip; hold your E Ashen Pursuit to dodge the flip's recast and she loses her engage.
edits.after: Akali pokes with Q Five Point Strike, which slows but does not heal her, then all-ins with E Shuriken Flip; hold your E Ashen Pursuit to dodge the recast and she loses her engage.

edits.before: Her R Perfect Execution gives dashes, but your R Purgatory totem executes her out of her own shroud combo before her second cast lands — your kill window.
edits.after: Her R Perfect Execution is two dashes, but Purgatory grounds — drop it on her and both casts die, so hold it for the moment she steps out of Twilight Shroud.

edits.before: With her first component her shroud plus burst can delete you, but you match her assassin pattern and your P Silver Stake chunks her low base HP.
edits.after: With her first component her shroud plus burst can delete you, but you match her assassin pattern and your missing-health on-hit chunks her thin HP bar.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are even: Akali's Q pokes and heals but costs heavy energy, so trade back with Ritual Nails autos and she can't sustain a war without going empty.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are even: Akali's Q pokes and slows but costs heavy energy, so trade back with Soul Nails marks and she cannot sustain a war without going empty.

edits.before: Through 3-6 it stays skill-based — she wants shroud-to-flip all-ins while you use E Ashen Pursuit to dodge and P Silver Stake to punish her thin HP bar; energy management decides it.
edits.after: Through 3-6 it stays skill-based — she wants shroud-to-flip all-ins while you use E Ashen Pursuit, up every 10s, to dodge and punish her thin HP bar; energy management decides it.

edits.before: After items it's a coinflip of assassin combos, but your Level 6 R Purgatory executes her before her shroud reset saves her, which is your one clear edge in an otherwise even fight.
edits.after: After items it's a coinflip of assassin combos, but R Purgatory grounds her out of the Shuriken Flip recast and both Perfect Execution dashes — your one clear edge in an even fight.

edits.before: Land R Purgatory to execute through her W shroud
edits.after: Land R Purgatory as she exits W to ground her dash

edits.before: Land Q Five Point Strike at range to poke and heal
edits.after: Land Q Five Point Strike at range to poke and slow

edits.before: Locke favoured — R Purgatory executes her through the shroud combo.
edits.after: Locke favoured — Purgatory grounds her dash escapes after the shroud.

notes: Twilight Shroud makes Akali unselectable by spells and attacks, so any advice to land a targeted spell 'through' the shroud is wrong; the correct play is the grounding zone on her exit. Whether Purgatory's projectile can be placed under an untargetable champion (ground-targeted vs unit-targeted) is not answerable from the kit text — the wording used avoids depending on it. 'Silver Stake' is not a name present in Locke's kit file and was not reused.
